title: Testing
explain: Go has testing built in. Put tests in files ending in `_test.go`, name each one `TestSomething`, and run them all with `go test`. A test fails when it calls `t.Errorf` or `t.Fatal`.
exercise: Write a table-driven test for `Add` with at least four cases, including negative numbers.
tip: Table-driven tests keep many cases short. Loop over a slice of inputs and expected results instead of copying the test.
